title: Task Learning
description: Inspect desktop-local evaluated outcomes, delayed revisions, and policy priors for the task-learning loop.

hero.title: See what AI did, and help it do better.
hero.description: Every time AI handles a task for you, it records its decision process. Review those records here, tell it what went well and what needs fixing — it learns and improves from every piece of feedback.

detail.title: Review Panel
detail.description: Select a task record, then follow three steps to review it.
detail.feedbackHint: Tell AI how this run performed. Your feedback directly shapes its next decision.
detail.empty: Pick a task record from the list on the left to see what AI did and give your feedback.
detail.noRevisions: This task hasn't received any feedback yet.
detail.notePlaceholder: Want to add a comment? Share your thoughts or suggestions (optional)

guide.step0Hint: Start by reviewing how AI handled this task and what the outcome was. Expand the technical snapshot for more details if needed.
guide.step1Hint: Your turn! After reviewing, tell AI how it did. Every piece of feedback helps it make better decisions next time.
guide.step2Hint: Here you can see all previous feedback for this task — a trail of how AI was gradually corrected and improved.

timeline.profileDesc: Identify the task goal, output shape, and risk profile.
timeline.routeDesc: Pick the most suitable route based on the detected task shape.
timeline.executionDesc: Evaluate the result using execution outcome, verification strength, and tool usage.
timeline.learningDesc: Decide whether this run should update the policy layer.

priors.title: What AI Has Learned
priors.description: These are decision rules AI has learned from your feedback. The more experience and confidence it has, the better it handles similar tasks next time.
priors.empty: AI hasn't gathered enough experience yet. Give it a few more reviews and it will start recognizing patterns.
